metadata.case_name: SATTAR K.A. v. GOODRICH TRANSPORTATION (HK) LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: worker responsible for delivery of goods / delivery worker

source: X-ray of his right ankle showed fracture of right lower fibula.
X-rays of right ankle showed that the fracture has healed with satisfactory alignment.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

manifestations.description: tenderness and swelling over right lateral malleolus and right lower fibula
mild ankle pain on prolonged walking and standing
range of motion of his right ankle was mildly reduced, 5º difference between left and right ankles in pointing toes upwards and pointing toes downwards
walked with normal gait; could walk on his heels; could walk on tiptoes; squatted fully; had no obvious deformity, swelling or muscle wasting of the right ankle

treatments_received: admitted to the orthopedic ward at QEH
follow-up consultation and treatment at out-patient clinic

comparable_cases.injury_description: sustained a fracture to his ankle and a torn ligament; he no longer plays football
